title: Passage of Water
context: Yiyun Kang, Google Arts & Culture, NASA JPL
paragraphs: An artwork by Yiyun Kang, developed in collaboration with Google Arts & Culture and NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, examining Earth’s freshwater through GRACE and SWOT satellite data.
Jeanyoon Choi contributed web development, data analysis and visualisation from July to December 2023. The work was presented online and at UNFCCC COP28 in Dubai.
